Hyundai Newsroom|website=www.hyundainews.com}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.motortrend.com/cars/hyundai/palisade/|title = 2022 Hyundai Palisade Buyer's Guide: Reviews, Specs, Comparisons}} | body_style = 5-door [[Sport utility vehicle|SUV]] | related = [[Kia Telluride]] | predecessor = [[Hyundai Santa Fe#Maxcruz|Hyundai Maxcruz/Santa Fe XL]] | layout = {{unbulleted list |[[Front-engine, front-wheel-drive layout|Front-engine, front-wheel-drive]] |[[Front-engine, four-wheel-drive layout|Front-engine, all-wheel-drive]] }} | chassis = [[Unibody]] | caption = Second-generation Palisade }} The '''Hyundai Palisade''' ({{langx|ko|현대 팰리세이드}}) is a [[mid-size crossover SUV]]{{Cite web |date=September 1, 2020 |title=Hyundai Palisade Prices, Reviews, and Pictures {{!}} Edmunds |url=https://www.edmunds.com/hyundai/palisade/ |website=Edmunds}} manufactured and marketed by [[Hyundai Motor Company]] since late 2018, replacing the Maxcruz (also known as [[Hyundai Santa Fe|Santa Fe]] XL outside of South Korea) as the flagship SUV under the Hyundai brand. The term ''[[palisade]]'' means a fence of defensive stakes or a series of coastal cliffs — the latter recalling the neighborhood of [[Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles]] or the nearly forty-mile [[Hudson River]] palisade, running north from opposite Manhattan.{{Cite web|title=Hyundai Palisade etymology: What does its name mean or come from?|url=https://www.betweentheaxles.net/hyundai-palisade-etymology-what-does-its-name-mean-or-come-from-19766|last=Fung|first=Derek|date=2018-11-19|website=Between the Axles|language=en-US|access-date=2020-05-07}} {{TOC limit|4}} {{Clear}} == First generation (LX2; 2018) == {{Infobox automobile | name = First generation | image = Hyundai Palisade LX2 Steel Graphite (7).jpg | model_code = LX2 | production = 2018–2025 | model_years = 2020–2025 | assembly = {{ubl | South Korea: [[Ulsan]] ([[Hyundai Ulsan Plant|Ulsan Plant 2]]) | Russia: [[Kaliningrad]] ([[Avtotor]]) | Vietnam: [[Ninh Bình]] ([[Hyundai Thanh Cong Manufacturing Vietnam|HTMV]]) }} | designer = Kim Jun-Ho, Seo Jin-Hwan and Kim Gil-Ho{{Cite patent|number=USD893355S1|title=Automobile|gdate=2020-08-18|invent1=Kim|invent2=Seo|invent3=Kim|inventor1-first=Jun Ho|inventor2-first=Jin Hwan|inventor3-first=Gil Ho|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/USD893355S1/en}} | layout = | engine = {{ubl | '''[[Petrol engine|Petrol]]:''' | 3.5 L [[Hyundai Lambda engine#G6DC|''Lambda II'']] [[V6 engine|V6]] | 3.8 L [[Hyundai Lambda engine#G6DN|''Lambda II'']] [[Gasoline direct injection|GDi]] V6 | '''[[Diesel engine|Diesel]]:''' | 2.2 L [[Hyundai R engine#D4HB|''R II'']] [[Common rail|CRDi]] [[Straight-four engine|I4]] }} | transmission = 8-speed ''[[List of Hyundai transmissions#A8LF1|A8LF1]]''/''[[List of Hyundai transmissions#A8LF2|A8LF2]]'' [[automatic transmission|automatic]] | wheelbase = {{cvt|2900|mm|in|1}} | length = {{ubl | {{cvt|4980|mm|in|1}} (pre-facelift) | {{cvt|4995|mm|in|1}} (facelift) }} | width = {{cvt|1975|mm|in|1}} | height = {{cvt|1750|mm|in|1}} | weight = {{cvt|1820|-|2060|kg|lb|0}} | platform = [[Hyundai-Kia N platforms|Hyundai-Kia N1/N2]]https://www.carsales.com.au/editorial/details/hyundai-palisade-2021-review-127880/ | related = [[Kia Telluride#ON|Kia Telluride (ON)]] }} === Overview === The Palisade debuted at the [[LA Auto Show#2018|2018 Los Angeles Auto Show]] on 28 November 2018,{{Cite web |last=Palmer |first=Zac |date=2018-11-28 |title=Hyundai Palisade SUV supersizes it at L.A. Auto Show |url=https://www.autoblog.com/news/hyundai-palisade-suv-supersizes-it-at-at-l-a-auto-show |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=Autoblog |language=en}} having been previewed by Hyundai's Grandmaster concept of June 2018.{{Cite web |last=Padeanu |first=Adrian |date=2018-06-08 |title=Hyundai Grandmaster Concept Could Hint At Fullsize SUV [UPDATE] |url=https://www.motor1.com/news/244275/hyundai-grandmaster-concept-revealed/ |access-date=2022-07-31 |website=Motor1.com |language=en}} The Palisade is Hyundai's largest passenger vehicle to date, measuring {{convert|4980|mm|in|1|abbr=on}} long with a wheelbase of {{convert|2900|mm|in|1|abbr=on}} inches.{{Cite news |date=28 November 2018 |title=2020 Hyundai Palisade First Look: A New Flagship |newspaper=Motortrend |url=https://www.motortrend.com/news/2020-hyundai-palisade-first-look-review/}} It has {{convert|21|cuft|L|0|abbr=on}} of cargo space behind the third row and {{convert|87|cuft|L|0|abbr=on}} with both rows folded down.{{Cite web |last=Flierl |first=Denis |date=2019-10-25 |title=2020 Hyundai Palisade Limited Review: How Does Hyundai's New SUV Stack Up? |url=https://www.automoblog.net/2019/10/25/2020-hyundai-palisade-limited-review/ |access-date=2019-11-27 |website=Automoblog |language=en-US}} Like its predecessor, the Palisade features three rows of seating, with seating for up to eight passengers when equipped with a second-row bench seat or seven passengers with the optional second-row captain seat. The vehicle rated a [[Drag coefficient|coefficient drag]] of 0.33, achieved with an optimised front cooling area with extended internal air guide, aerodynamic underside panels with full front and centre underbody covers, and rear wheel aero deflectors.{{Cite web |date=2018-11-29 |title=2020 Hyundai Palisade debuts - flagship eight-seat SUV, 3.8L V6, 8-speed auto, flush with safety tech |url=https://paultan.org/2018/11/29/2020-hyundai-palisade-debuts-at-la-auto-show-flagship-eight-seat-suv/ |access-date=2022-07-31 |website=Paul Tan's Automotive News |language=en-US}} Introduction of the right-hand drive model started in December 2020 in Australia and Indonesia.{{Cite web |last=Dowling |first=Joshua |date=2020-06-26 |title=2021 Hyundai Palisade SUV confirmed for Australia |url=https://www.drive.com.au/news/2021-hyundai-palisade-suv-confirmed-for-australia/ |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=Drive |language=en}} [[Knock-down kit|CKD]] assembly in Russia started in 2020 by [[Avtotor]] for domestic sales.{{Cite news |last= |date=2020-10-24 |title=Hyundai Palisade will reach Russia with two engines - DRIVE |website=Tek Deeps |language=en-US}} File:Hyundai Palisade LX2 Steel Graphite (17).jpg|Rear view File:Hyundai Palisade Calligraphy.jpg|Palisade Calligraphy (pre-facelift) File:2021 Hyundai Palisade 2.2 Signature (Indonesia) interior.jpg|Interior === Markets === ==== Asia ==== ===== Indonesia ===== The Palisade went on sale in Indonesia in January 2021 after December 2020 introduction. It is offered in Prime and Signature trim levels with all-wheel drive only available for the latter trim and all variants use a 2.2-litre turbo-diesel engine.{{Cite web |date=2020-12-16 |title=Meluncur Januari 2021, Ini Spesifikasi Hyundai Palisade di Indonesia |trans-title=Launching January 2021, Here are the Specifications of the Hyundai Palisade in Indonesia |url=https://otomotif.kompas.com/read/2020/12/16/142100615/meluncur-januari-2021-ini-spesifikasi-hyundai-palisade-di-indonesia |website=Kompas |language=id}} The facelifted model debuted in July 2022.{{Cite web |last=Fachrulrazi |first=Ardaniel |date=2022-07-29 |title=Hyundai Luncurkan Palisade Facelift, Banyak Fitur Baru! |trans-title=Hyundai Launches Palisade Facelift, Lots of New Features! |url=https://autonetmagz.com/hyundai-luncurkan-palisade-facelift-banyak-fitur-baru/109722/ |access-date=2022-07-31 |website=AutonetMagz :: Review Mobil dan Motor Baru Indonesia |language=en-US}} The XRT variant was made available in June 2024.{{Cite web |last=Nurhuda |first=Septian Farhan |date=2024-06-01 |title=Harga Hyundai Palisade XRT Diumumkan, Tembus Rp 1 Miliar! |trans-title=Hyundai Palisade XRT Price Announced, Reaches IDR 1 Billion! |url=https://oto.detik.com/mobil/d-7368929/harga-hyundai-palisade-xrt-diumumkan-tembus-rp-1-miliar |access-date=2025-03-12 |website=detikoto |language=id-ID}} ===== Malaysia ===== The Palisade was launched in Malaysia on 16 December 2021. At launch, it is offered in Luxe and Exec variants with available 7- and 8-seater configurations and available with two engine option; a 3.8-litre V6 petrol front-wheel drive (Luxe) or 2.2-litre turbo-diesel all-wheel drive (Exec).{{Cite web |last=Lye |first=Gerard |date=2021-12-16 |title=2022 Hyundai Palisade launched in Malaysia - 3.8L petrol and 2.2L diesel; 8 or 7 seats; from RM329k |url=https://paultan.org/2021/12/16/2022-hyundai-palisade-launched-in-malaysia-3-8l-petrol-and-2-2l-diesel-8-or-7-seats-from-rm329k/ |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=Paul Tan's Automotive News |language=en-US}} The facelifted model debuted in January 2023 with same seating configuration and engine options as the pre-facelift model.{{Cite web |last=Chan |first=Mick |date=2023-01-20 |title=2023 Hyundai Palisade facelift launched in Malaysia - 8- and 7-seater, 2.2L diesel and 3.8L petrol, fr RM369k |url=https://paultan.org/2023/01/20/2023-hyundai-palisade-facelift-launched-in-malaysia-8-and-7-seater-2-2l-diesel-and-3-8l-petrol-fr-rm369k/ |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=Paul Tan's Automotive News |language=en-US}} ===== Philippines ===== The Palisade was launched in the Philippines in April 2019. At launch, it was offered as a sole variant with 2.2-litre turbo-diesel engine and a 7-seat configuration.{{Cite news |url=https://www.autoindustriya.com/auto-industry-news/you-got-php-3-24-million-for-the-2019-hyundai-palisade.html|title=You got PhP 3.24 million for the 2019 Hyundai Palisade? |work=AutoIndustriya.com |date=2019-04-04 |access-date=2020-12-16}} The facelifted model debuted in January 2023 only available on special order.{{Cite news |date=2023-01-01 |title=Hyundai Palisade SUV Returns To Philippines With P 3.780M Price Tag (w/ Specs) |url=https://www.carguide.ph/2023/01/hyundai-palisade-suv-returns-to.html |work=CarGuide.PH}} ===== Singapore ===== The Palisade was launched in Singapore on 30 April 2021 in a sole variant with a 8-seater configuration and uses a 3.5-litre V6 petrol engine.{{Cite web |last=Chia |first=Ben |date=2021-04-30 |title=Hyundai Palisade lands in Singapore [UPDATED] |url=https://carbuyer.com.sg/hyundai-palisade-lands-in-singapore/ |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=Online Car Marketplace for Used & New Cars |language=en-US}} The facelifted model debuted in January 2023 as a 7-seater configuration.{{Cite web |date=2023-01-26 |title=Hyundai launches facelifted Palisade here in Singapore |url=https://www.sgcarmart.com/articles/news/hyundai-launches-facelifted-palisade-here-in-singapore-29736 |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=Sgcarmart |language=en-us}} ===== South Korea ===== Ahead of its official launch on 11 December 2018 in the country, the Palisade was first seen by the public through the third and fourth episodes of the [[Korean drama]] ''[[Encounter (South Korean TV series)|Encounter]]'' starring [[Song Hye-kyo]] and [[Park Bo-gum]] which aired on 5–6 December 2018, respectively.{{Cite web |date=2018-12-07 |title=현대차 대형 SUV 팰리세이드, 드라마 남자친구서 먼저 공개 |url=https://www.donga.com/news/article/all/20181207/93198571/2 |access-date=2026-01-26 |website=동아일보 |language=ko}}{{Cite web |last=최기성 |date=2018-12-07 |title=현대 팰리세이드, 드라마 `남자친구`로 국내 데뷔 |url=https://www.mk.co.kr/news/business/8589343 |access-date=2026-01-26 |website=매일경제 |language=ko}} The [[K-pop]] group [[BTS (band)|BTS]] was chosen as the brand ambassador for the new model of Hyundai and have since been involved in numerous commercials and ad campaigns in South Korea and U.S.{{Cite web |date=2018-11-27 |title=K-pop superstar BTS to pitch Hyundai Palisade at LA Auto Show - 매일경제 영문뉴스 펄스(Pulse) |trans-title=K-pop superstar BTS to pitch Hyundai Palisade at LA Auto Show |url=https://pulse.mk.co.kr/news/english/8574652 |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=Pulse |language=en}} The car sold faster than expected in South Korea, with over 52,000 units sold by February 2019. The unprecedented demand led to significant delays in supply throughout 2019, with customers having to wait up to 9 months to receive their vehicle.{{cite web |last1=Jin |first1=Sang-hoon |date=19 February 2019 |title=車받는데 9개월…현대차 '팰리세이드 수급대란' 왜? |trans-title=It took 9 months to receive the car… Why is Hyundai Motor Company’s ‘Palisade supply crisis’? |url=https://biz.chosun.com/site/data/html_dir/2019/02/19/2019021900283.html |access-date=29 March 2025 |website=Chosun Biz |publisher=Chosun Ilbo |language=Korean}} ===== Thailand ===== The Palisade was launched in Thailand on 8 November 2024 with a facelifted model. Imported from Vietnam, it is offered in Exclusive 2WD and Prestige AWD trim levels all variants use a 2.2-litre turbo-diesel engine.{{Cite web |date=2024-10-31 |title=เปิดสเป็คและข้อมูล Hyundai PALISADE เวอร์ชั่นไทย 2 รุ่นย่อย Exclusive 2WD และ Prestige 4WD |trans-title=Open specifications and information Hyundai PALISADE Thai version, 2 sub-models Exclusive 2WD and Prestige 4WD |url=https://www.headlightmag.com/hyundai-palisade-thailand-specs-unveiled/ |access-date=2024-10-31 |website=HeadLight Magazine |language=th}}{{Cite web |date=2024-11-08 |title=ราคาอย่างเป็นทางการ Hyundai PALISADE : 2,299,000 – 2,499,000 บาท SUV เบาะ 3 แถว 7 ที่นั่ง ดีเซล 2.2L Turbo 197 แรงม้า |trans-title=Official price Hyundai PALISADE : 2,299,000 – 2,499,000 baht SUV 3 rows seating, 7 seater, diesel 2.2L Turbo 197 horsepower |url=https://www.headlightmag.com/official-price-hyundai-palisade/ |access-date=2024-11-08 |website=HeadLight Magazine |language=th}} ===== Vietnam ===== The Palisade was launched on 15 September 2023 in Vietnam as a local assembled model at HTMV plant in Ninh Bình. It is offered in Exclusive and Prestige trim levels with 6 and 7-seater configurations and all variants use a 2.2-litre turbo-diesel engine.{{Cite web |last= |date=2023-09-15 |title=Hyundai Palisade - tân binh SUV cỡ E giá 1,47-1,59 tỷ đồng |trans-title=Hyundai Palisade - new E-size SUV priced at 1.47-1.59 billion VND |url=https://vnexpress.net/hyundai-palisade-tan-binh-suv-co-e-gia-1-47-1-59-ty-dong-4653551.html |access-date=2023-09-15 |website=VnExpress |language=vi}} ==== North America ==== Trim levels available for the Palisade in the United States and Canada are the base preferred, essential with optional Convenience Package or Convenience and Premium Package, Limited, and top-of-the-line Calligraphy (since 2021 model year). Powering all Palisade models is a 3.8-litre [[Atkinson cycle]] [[V6]] engine with Idle Stop & Go (ISG).{{Cite web |last=Gauthier |first=Michael |date=2020-07-12 |title=2021 Hyundai Palisade Gains More Equipment And Luxurious New Calligraphy Trim |url=https://www.carscoops.com/2020/07/2021-hyundai-palisade-gains-more-equipment-and-luxurious-new-calligraphy-trim/ |website=Carscoops}} ==== Oceania ==== ===== Australia ===== The Palisade was released in Australia in December 2020, after the right-hand drive model was finalized.{{Cite web|last=Leech|first=Spencer|date=2019-03-21|title=Hyundai mini-SUV undergoes local testing|url=https://www.goauto.com.au/future-models/hyundai/qx/hyundai-mini-suv-undergoes-local-testing/2019-03-21/78106.html|access-date=2021-08-21|website=GoAuto|language=en}} At launch, It is available in either 7- or 8-seater configuration on the Highlander trim and 8 seater on the standard trim. The Palisade is available with either a 3.8-litre V6 petrol front-wheel drive or 2.2-litre turbo-diesel all-wheel drive.{{Cite web |last=Wong |first=James |date=2020-11-20 |title=2021 Hyundai Palisade: Initial specs |url=https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2021-hyundai-palisade-initial-specs |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=CarExpert |language=en}} The Elite trim (which sits between the standard and Highlander trim levels) was added in August 2021.{{Cite web |last=Wong |first=James |date=2021-08-27 |title=2022 Hyundai Palisade price and specs |url=https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2022-hyundai-palisade-price-and-specs |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=CarExpert |language=en}} The facelifted model debuted in August 2022, with the standard trim discontinued.{{Cite web |last=Stopford |first=William |date=2022-07-27 |title=2023 Hyundai Palisade price and specs |url=https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2023-hyundai-palisade-price-and-specs |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=CarExpert |language=en}} The Highlander was replaced by the Calligraphy trim and the Calligraphy trim is available with the Black Ink styling package.{{Cite web |last=Quick |first=Jack |date=2023-10-16 |title=2024 Hyundai Palisade price and specs |url=https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2024-hyundai-palisade-price-and-specs |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=CarExpert |language=en}} ===== New Zealand ===== The Palisade was launched in New Zealand on 13 January 2021, with two trim levels: Elite (8-seater) and Limited (7-seater). For engines, both trims were available with either a 3.8-litre V6 petrol (2WD) or 2.2-litre turbo-diesel (AWD).{{Cite web |last=Alvrez |first=Fred |date=2021-01-12 |title=Hyundai Palisade SUV arrives in New Zealand |url=https://www.drivelife.co.nz/2021/01/hyundai-palisade-suv-arrives-in-new-zealand/ |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=DriveLife |language=en-GB}} ==== Russia ==== The Palisade was launched to the Russian market in December 2020 with 2.2-litre turbo-diesel engine and 3.5-litre V6 petrol engine rated at {{convert|249|hp|kW|0|abbr=on}}.{{cite web |author= |date= |title=Hyundai Palisade |url=https://wroom.ru/cars/hyundai/palisade |access-date=2021-02-12 |website=Wroom.ru |publisher= |language=ru |quote=}} It was locally assembled at the [[Avtotor]] plant in [[Kaliningrad]]. ==== South Africa ==== The Palisade was launched in South Africa on 13 August 2021. It is offered in a sole Elite trim with available 7- and 8-seater configurations and use a 2.2-litre turbo-diesel engine.{{Cite news |last=Du Toit |first=Albert |date=2021-08-13 |title=Hyundai Palisade 8-seater SUV – South African pricing |url=https://topauto.co.za/news/22674/hyundai-palisade-8-seater-suv-south-african-pricing/ |work=TopAuto}} The facelifted model debuted in February 2023.{{Cite news |last=Taylor |first=Michael |date=2023-02-23 |title=Facelifted Hyundai Palisade in South Africa – Pricing and features |url=https://topauto.co.za/news/69086/facelifted-hyundai-palisade-in-south-africa-pricing-and-features/ |work=TopAuto}} === Facelift === The updated Palisade debuted for the North American market at the [[New York International Auto Show#2022|New York International Auto Show]] on 13 April 2022, for the 2023 model year.{{Cite news |last=Miller |first=Caleb |date=2022-04-13 |title=2023 Hyundai Palisade Sports a Bolder Face and More Tech |url=https://www.caranddriver.com/news/a39702267/2023-hyundai-palisade-revealed/ |access-date=April 13, 2022 |work=Car And Driver}}{{Cite news |last=Normile |first=Brian |date=2022-04-13 |title=Up Close With the 2023 Hyundai Palisade |url=https://www.cars.com/articles/up-close-with-the-2023-hyundai-palisade-448894/ |access-date=April 13, 2022 |work=Cars.com}} It features a revised front end, and an enhanced infotainment system with 12-inch navigation.{{Cite news |last=Duffer |first=Robert |date=2022-04-16 |title=2023 Kia Telluride and Hyundai Palisade headline this week's new car reviews |url=https://www.thecarconnection.com/news/1135602_2023-kia-telluride-and-hyundai-palisade-headline-this-week-s-new-car-reviews |access-date=April 16, 2022 |work=The Car Connection}} In South Korea, the updated Palisade was released on 19 May 2022, following its physical release at the 2022 New York International Auto Show.{{Cite news |last=Kyong-ae |first=Choi |date=2022-05-18 |title=Hyundai to launch upgraded Palisade SUV this week |url=https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20220518001900320 |access-date=April 13, 2022 |work=Yonhap News Agency}} The thickness of the sound-absorbing material was increased and the shock-absorbing device was improved. In addition, technologies such as Digital Key 2 and second-row ventilation seats became an option. boxy shape for the exterior design. The exterior design elements includes vertical rectangular LED headlights with LED DRLs, and a thin LED light strip across the upper section of grille, silver-finished D-pillar trim piece on the side, the rear fascia features a minimalistic design, the vertical taillights resembles the headlights, the rear wiper is hidden underneath the roof spoiler, and a faux skidplate on the lower part of the rear bumper with the exhaust pipes tucked away. The Palisade has a longer wheelbase compared to its predecessor, with a shorter front overhang and stretched rear overhang. Inside, the 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment and instrument cluster screens are housed within the wraparound design of the upper dashboard. The lower part of the dashboard features the air-con vents and the physical switches. The centre console is disconnected from the dashboard, providing additional storage space below and features a wireless charger, 100W USB charging outlet and storage cubby. The gear selector used for the automatic transmission is relocated from the centre console to the steering wheel column. The Palisade is available as a 9-seater configuration for the first time in addition to the 7-seater configuration, with the front centre console doubles as an additional seat, therefore making it eligible to drive through bus lanes in South Korea. The second row comes as either with captain seat or a bench seat, while the third row gets a 60:40 split bench seat as standard. The Hyundai Palisade (Korean: 현대 팰리세이드) is a mid-size crossover SUV manufactured and marketed by Hyundai Motor Company since late 2018, replacing the Maxcruz (also known as Santa Fe XL outside of South Korea) as the flagship SUV under the Hyundai brand.
The term palisade means a fence of defensive stakes or a series of coastal cliffs — the latter recalling the neighborhood of Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles or the nearly forty-mile Hudson River palisade, running north from opposite Manhattan.
